market.question: Will the highest temperature in Beijing be 23°C on May 3?

assessment.reasoning: Beijing Capital Airport early-May average high ~26°C; first ten days of May average ~26°C. The 23°C bucket is ~3°C below typical. Possible but less likely than the modal 25-27°C buckets. Probability ~15-20%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cool front passage could drop highs into low 20s on May 3.
